item.title: Special Tours
item.description: Special tours combining adventure and culture UD Travels Chases Excellence Special Tour Unique Divine Travels designs special tours for travelers seeking adventure combined with cultural and natural heritage. The program includes trekking, rafting, wildlife safaris, and authentic cultural experiences. Season: March to May and September through December Day 1: Arrive in Paro Reception at Paro airport by our guide and driver; Visit Ta Dzong museum showcasing Bhutanese art and artifacts; and Night halt in hotel.
